positive.point: Lifetime access to Snell Library with the alumni card, which is appreciated for its extensive collection and ability to obtain books from other sources.
A 6-month grace period for alumni to use the Marino gym without needing to immediately purchase an alumni membership.

negative.point: Loss of access to Canva after switching to an alumni account, which is concerning for those who have many projects stored there.
Uncertainty about whether emails sent to the original student address are auto-forwarded to the alumni inbox, causing potential inconvenience.
Need to pay for an alumni membership to continue using the Marino gym after the grace period ends.
